clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Orgrimmar, Spells of Shadow rests in the hands of Searing Blade cultists. The Forsaken leadership in the Undercity wants the grimoire recovered.

Searing Blade cultists keep Spells of Shadow among their guarded treasures in Ragefire Chasm. The splinter cult is tied to the Shadow Council, and its members wield dark rites granted by demon masters of the Burning Legion. The book holds shadow and fel sorcery. Cultists and warlocks keep it close as they plot beneath the Horde in Durotar.

Word of the Searing Blade's demonic gifts reached the Undercity's royal quarters. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and her dreadlord lieutenant, Varimathras, decided the relics were wasted on cultists with lesser vision. Varimathras sends Horde adventurers into Ragefire Chasm to seize Spells of Shadow and its companion tome, Incantations from the Nether. Their power is meant to serve the Forsaken cause against the Scourge and the Lich King.
